contractor.bio: Chief Master Contractor specialized in turnkey structural temple construction across Pan-India. Carrying forward a 4-generation family legacy of Shilpa Shastra, we supply stone directly from private quarries, manage in-house carving guilds (Karigars), handle structural RCC/stone foundation civil work, and erect towering Shikharas and Rajagopurams to the exact astrological and Vastu rules.
specializations: Turnkey Pan-India Stone & RCC Temple Contracts
Nagara Curvilinear Spire (Latina & Sekhari) Corbelled Construction
Hoysala Stellate Star Plan Soapstone & Schist Carving
Zero Iron Bar Sanctum Masonry (Engineered for 1,000+ Years Longevity)

temples.name: Sri Maha Rajagopuram Devasthanam
temples.stoneType: Pristine Makrana Marble & Monolithic White Granite
temples.description: A monumental pure white Dravidian Rajagopuram masterpiece featuring intricate multi-tiered white stone masonry with golden deity sculptures on every course, culminating in 9 pure gold-leafed Kalasham pinnacles. Erected by our chief master contractor and travelling guild.
features: White stone multi-tier Rajagopuram with gold-plated deities
81-Cell Paramasayika Vastupurusha Mandala core alignment
Dry-fit assembled at Pune karkhana before ground crane installation
Deepastambha and monolithic stone gateway sentinels

temples.name: Shree Somnath Heritage Maha Mandir
temples.description: A monumental 7-tiered Nagara style sandstone temple built according to the classical Shilpa Ratnakara treatises. Featuring an expansive Sabha Mandapa with 72 hand-carved pillars, a gold-plated Kalasha crown, and an impenetrable corbelled shikhara.
features: Corbelled hollow shikhara with parabolic curvature
Zero artificial iron bars used in core sanctum stone joints
Ornate Rangamandapa with carved dome ceiling

temples.name: Chennakesava Vesara Heritage Complex
temples.description: The pinnacle of Deccan Hoysala & Chalukya fusion architecture. Raised upon a 5-foot star-shaped Jagati plinth with intricate friezes of elephants, lions, and dancing Madanikas with lathe-turned pillars.
features: 16-pointed stellate star foundation geometry
Over 650 hand-carved frieze panels
Lathe-turned monolithic soapstone pillars

temples.name: Radha Krishna Pristine Marble Sanctum
temples.description: Carved entirely in Grade-A Makrana marble at our specialized karkhana, every stone is dry-fitted and crated for assembly by our master Karigars.
features: Translucent Makrana marble with illuminated sanctum
Elaborate peacocks and floral jali stone lattice screens
Full circumambulatory pradakshina path

temples.name: Maha Ganapati Shilpa Devasthanam
temples.description: Traditional Dravidian sanctum with hand-carved monolithic Deepastambha lamp tower and 32 postures of Lord Ganesha sculpted along outer walls.
features: Monolithic granite Deepastambha lamp pillar
Integrated shaded stone portico and pradakshina

temples.name: Sri Maha Shikhara Live Brick & Stone Superstructure
temples.stoneType: High-Grade Kiln Brick & Basalt Stone Core
temples.description: Live on-site structural erection of a classical multi-tier corbelled Shikhara tower. Crafted using traditional stepped interlocking geometry with heavy bamboo scaffolding, featuring stepped cornices, miniature niche recesses, and spherical amalaka base.
features: Live on-site stepped brick & stone shikhara masonry
Traditional bamboo scaffolding engineered for elevation safety
Corbelled hollow-core geometry according to Shilpa Shastra
Precision lime & cement bonding for 500+ year longevity

temples.name: Sri Maha Sabha Mandapa & Monolithic Pillared Hall
temples.subType: Monolithic Stone Pillars & Elevated Sanctum Shikhara
temples.stoneType: Solid Dressed Granite Pillars & Brick Superstructure
temples.description: On-site erection of a massive open Sabha Mandapa featuring 16 hand-dressed monolithic stone pillars, heavy stone lintel beams, cantilevered stone sunshades (Chhajjas), and an elevated brick Shikhara under active scaffolding.
features: Hand-dressed monolithic granite pillar columns and bracket capitals
Interlocking dry-joint beam-and-lintel structural assembly
Elevated stone plinth (Adhishthana) with dressed perimeter walls
Integrated covered circumambulation hall (Pradakshina Path)

temples.name: Sri Mahadwara & Ornamental Temple Archway
temples.subType: Carved White Archway Mahadwara with Murti Niche
temples.stoneType: White Monolith Stone & Carved Lime Stucco
temples.description: Completed grand Mahadwara entrance portal featuring hand-sculpted floral columns, ornate pediment with seated saint sculpture in sanctum niche, ceremonial brass flagpost (Dhwaja Stambha), and perimeter enclosure wall.
features: Hand-sculpted relief floral pillar shafts and brackets
Central archway pediment housing sanctified deity niche
Weather-resistant sacred white lime finish
Cast iron decorative gate with solar motif symbols

temples.name: High Elevation Shikhara Artisans & Spire Detailing
temples.subType: Live High-Altitude Shikhara Tier Carving & Masonry
temples.stoneType: Vedic Fired Red Brick & Hardstone Masonry
temples.description: Live on-site craftsmanship by our travelling master artisans carrying out precision brick alignment, tier shaping, and Kalasha pinnacle alignment at high elevation on bamboo staging.
features: Traditional plumb-line symmetry verification according to Shilpa Shastra
Artisans working at 35+ ft height on secure bamboo scaffolding
Precision stepped tier layering for optimal wind & seismic load dissipation
Complete turnkey civil & craft execution by Master Contractor

temples.name: Sri Suvarna Rajagopuram & Basalt Sanctum
temples.subType: Multi-Tier Golden Stepped Gopuram & Basalt Sanctum
temples.stoneType: Black Basalt Foundation Stone & Sculpted Lime Stucco
temples.description: A towering golden-yellow Dravidian Rajagopuram rising majestically above a polished black basalt sanctum base. Decorated with multiple tiers of sculpted devakoshta niches, dvarapalas, and culminating in a pure gold-leafed Kalasham finial.
features: Multi-tier stepped pyramidal Dravidian tower geometry
Solid dark basalt stone plinth and sanctum masonry
Ornate devakoshta deity niches on every tier
Consecrated golden Kalasham pinnacle

temples.name: Sri Durga Mahishasuramardini Twin Gopuram Mandir
temples.subType: Twin Polychrome Gopuram Spires with Carved Mandapa
temples.stoneType: Dressed Stone Pillars & Intricate Polychrome Stucco
temples.description: An architectural marvel featuring twin symmetrical polychrome Gopuram towers atop an ornate stone-pillared Mukha Mandapa, crowned by a central high-relief sculpture of Maa Durga slaying the demon Mahishasura.
features: Twin polychrome Dravidian Gopuram spires with golden Kalashams
High-relief Mahishasuramardini central arch sculpture
Dressed stone colonnade with ornamental elephant sentinels
Vivid traditional Agama temple color palette

temples.name: Sri Siddhivinayak Lotus Circular Shikhara
temples.stoneType: Stone Base with Intricate Filigree & Stucco Moulding
temples.description: A uniquely crafted circular & octagonal lotus-motif Shikhara inspired by Vesara temple spires. Features 8 arched sanctified niches housing Lord Ganesha in various mudras, surrounded by multi-colored filigree floral carvings.
features: Fluted circular lotus petal conical shikhara
8 radial devakoshta niches with sculpted deities
Fine scrollwork and traditional hand-painted floral motifs
Three-tier kalasha pinnacle with brass finial

temples.name: Sri Mahadev Nagara Fluted Spire & Gaja-Peetha Sanctum
temples.subType: Tall Fluted Stepped Spire with Elephant Base Frieze
temples.stoneType: Monolithic Carved Grey Stone & Polychrome Spire
temples.description: A grand Nagara style temple featuring a hand-carved stone Garbhagriha adorned with a continuous elephant frieze (Gaja-peetha) and wall deity niches, crowned by a towering multi-tier stepped and fluted colorful Shikhara.
features: Hand-carved continuous elephant frieze (Gaja-peetha) plinth
Dressed stone sanctum walls with deeply recessed deity niches
Stepped multi-tier fluted Nagara spire with saffron temple flag (Dhwaja)
100% turnkey execution from plinth to kalasha

temples.name: Sri Mahasannidhi Granite Dravidian Vimana Spire
temples.description: A magnificent multi-tiered Dravidian grey granite stone Vimana Shikhara adorned with kirtimukha architraves, sculpted niche devatas, and crowned with an intricate circular dome and kalasham finial.
features: Pure hand-dressed grey granite stone tiers
Ornate Kirtimukha and Sala-sikhara roof motifs
Deeply sculpted devakoshta sanctum alcoves
Precision interlocking dry-joint stone engineering

temples.name: Monolithic Yali & Gaja Stambha Mandapa Pillar
temples.subType: Monolithic Mythical Yali Beast & Rider Pillar
temples.description: An awe-inspiring monolithic granite pillar sculpted with a rearing mythical Yali beast, royal warrior rider, and elephant pedestal (Gaja-peetha) in the classic Vijayanagara and Nayaka architectural tradition.
features: Carved from a single solid monolithic granite block
Dynamic rearing Yali with warrior and elephant base
Deep undercut filigree relief work
Architectural load-bearing Sabha Mandapa column

temples.name: Sri Shweta Mahadwara & Guru Sanctum Archway
temples.subType: Pristine White Dressed Dwarashala & Compound Arch
temples.stoneType: Sculpted Dressed Stone with Lime Plaster Finish
temples.description: An elegant consecrated ceremonial entrance Dwarashala and compound gate featuring a central Guru niche, ornate Dravidian cornice mouldings, and deep relief floral pillar pilasters.
features: Ornate white ceremonial temple gateway (Mahadwara)
Central deity/Guru niche with decorative Sala pediment
Deep relief floral pilaster carvings
Complete perimeter compound wall and entrance execution

temples.name: Sri Ganganbeed Lotus Shikhara Sanctum
temples.subType: Stepped Lotus Fluted Kalasha Shikhara & Ashlar Sanctum
temples.stoneType: Precision Ashlar Stone Masonry with Polychrome Shikhara
temples.description: A consecrated countryside shrine in Ganganbeed featuring precision coursed ashlar stone sanctum masonry, ornate floral doorframes (Dwarashakha), and a vibrant multi-tiered lotus petal stepped Shikhara culminating in an amalaka kalasha finial.
features: Multi-tiered stepped lotus petal circular Shikhara
Hand-dressed grey ashlar stone Garbhagriha walls
Carved floral entrance doorway (Dwarashakha)
Consecrated gold-leafed amalaka and kalasha pinnacle

temples.name: Sri Omkar Polychrome Sabha Mandapa & Nagara Shikhara
temples.subType: Pillared Sabha Mandapa with Nagara Spire & Kalashas
temples.stoneType: RCC Reinforced Core with Ornate Traditional Stucco Craft
temples.description: A magnificent open Sabha Mandapa temple with decorative multi-colored sculpted pillars, sacred Omkar sanctum arch, stepped plinth, and a soaring multi-tiered Nagara curvilinear Shikhara with dual tiered Kalasham pinnacles.
features: Open pillared Sabha Mandapa with ornate floral colonnade
Towering curvilinear Nagara Shikhara with sacred emblems
Carved Gajapitha elephant motifs along the Mandapa cornice
Dual consecrated Kalasha finials with traditional temple flag
